name: 32301 · Tallahassee, FL
findings: ZIP 32301 (Tallahassee) has 413 nonprofit organizations. 199 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 185 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32301 (Tallahassee) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
51% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
